description: This file contains unit tests for the ToolResultTextFormatter, validating its formatting behavior for plain text, JSON summaries, error messages, and unknown payloads.

classes.name: ToolResultTextFormatterTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases verifying the behavior of ToolResultTextFormatter.

methods.name: leavesPlainTextUntouched
methods.description: Tests that plain text input remains unchanged after formatting.

methods.name: summarizesNodesListJSON
methods.description: Tests formatting of a JSON containing nodes information, checking for summary and specific node details.

methods.name: summarizesErrorJSONAndDropsAgentPrefix
methods.description: Tests that an error JSON produces an error message and strips agent prefix information.

methods.name: suppressesUnknownStructuredPayload
methods.description: Tests that unrecognized JSON payloads result in an empty string.
